summary: Narrow static delta review confirms the prior direct-pause/completed-loop path and post-commit cancellation bookkeeping are corrected. Revised deadline, bounded-wait and cleanup controls address the specific test gaps. One supported incoming-settings restart gap remains.

findings.claim: The new incoming-pause branch cancels and clears loopTask, but an incoming paused=false update only restarts the collector. A running loop followed by direct settings true then false updates now loses periodic sampling indefinitely unless resume/start is separately called. Previously a quick true/false toggle while the loop slept left that timer alive. The new regression uses lifecycle.resume(), so it does not cover direct unpause.
findings.recommendation: Queue one epoch-checked restart after @Published commits the incoming false value. Preserve recovery-confirmation, sleep and terminal guards; obsolete callbacks must not restart monitoring. Test a false/true/false settings round trip without lifecycle.resume during periodic sleep, require another probe call, and cover an intervening pause/sleep/shutdown before the queued restart executes.
